alternate_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((runs (straight-runs g
                                       (lambda (v) (zero? v))
                                       (list (list 1 1) (list 1 -1)))))
             (define (score run)
               (let* ((cells (fst run))
                      (dir (snd run))
                      (start (fst cells))
                      (dc (snd dir)))
                 (+ (* (length cells) 10000)
                    (- (* (fst start) 100))
                    (if (= dc -1) (- w (snd start)) (snd start)))))
             (let ((best (fst (sort runs (lambda (a b) (> (score a) (score b)))))))
               (paint-cells g (fst best) 8))))))
canonical_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((runs (straight-runs g
                                       (lambda (v) (zero? v))
                                       (list (list 1 1) (list 1 -1)))))
             (define (score run)
               (let* ((cells (fst run))
                      (dir (snd run))
                      (start (fst cells))
                      (dc (snd dir)))
                 (+ (* (length cells) 10000)
                    (- (* (fst start) 100))
                    (if (= dc -1) (snd start) (- w (snd start))))))
             (let ((best (fst (sort runs (lambda (a b) (> (score a) (score b)))))))
               (paint-cells g (fst best) 8))))))
limits: One deterministic four-demo lesson and one reversed column tie-break rival; not a universal ambiguity claim.
